about: Display names for the parts kit. Ids never change; pages read names, families and hidden flags from here. Built by shared/engine/creature-catalog/build.py.

families.name: Wyrms
families.blurb: Long segmented bodies: worms, centiwyrms, leeches and serpents.

families.name: Swifts and lancers
families.blurb: Fast fliers with blade or sickle wings and lance tails.

families.name: Monarchs and seraphs
families.blurb: Haloed, crowned and many-eyed: the ornate winged ones.

families.name: Dragons
families.blurb: Winged and clawed, with draped or koi-finned wings.

families.name: Drifters
families.blurb: Soft floaters: jellies, wisps, glass stars and mantas.

families.name: Fish and puffers
families.blurb: Finned swimmers: koi, puffers and anglers.

families.name: Crawlers
families.blurb: Legged and armoured: pincers, carapaces and plates.

families.name: Marks and instruments
families.blurb: Not creatures: the glyph alphabet and dial parts.
